title: Always On My Mind | 30A Escapes
meta_description: BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.
description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents… "Always On My Mind," beautiful Gulf-front retreat in Seacrest West with panoramic Gulf views, a private pool and plenty of room to relax. Wake up to views of the water, enjoy your morning coffee on the balcony or spend the afternoon lounging beside the pool. With 5 bedrooms accommodating up to 12 guests across the main house and carriage house, there's space for everyone to settle in. Prepare dinner in the gourmet kitchen, gather around the dining table or enjoy an evening outside overlooking the Gulf. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Incredible Gulf-Front Views with panoramic views of the water from multiple living spacesPrivate Pool with Lounge Chairs – Relax by your own serene pool with chaise lounges, ideal for soaking up the sun or cooling off.Main House + Carriage House – Plenty of space with a detached carriage house for extra privacy, great for hosting family or friends.Gourmet Kitchen Overlooking the Gulf – Cook with high-end appliances and stunning Gulf views for a memorable experience.Spacious 5-Bedroom Retreat accommodating up to 12 guests with private bathrooms for every bedroomGulf-Front Balcony and outdoor living areas for enjoying the coastal scenery7 Bikes Included for exploring Scenic Highway 30A and nearby communitiesPrime Seacrest West Location near Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and local restaurantsEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Right on the beach. Amazing views and perfect for families!" – Bill B.⭐ "The perfect house and location for our group! Already booked for next year." – Carrie M.⭐ "Loved having private beach access and the poolside lounge area." – Linda T.*** LIVING AREAS ***The living spaces at "Always On My Mind" offer a comfortable place to gather while making the most of the home's beautiful Gulf-front setting. Floor-to-ceiling windows bring in plenty of natural light and showcase the panoramic views, while multiple living areas give everyone room to relax throughout their stay.Gulf-Front Living Area with comfortable seating and Smart TVLarge Furnished Balcony with panoramic Gulf views1st Floor Den with Comfortable Seating, Smart TV and Direct Pool Deck AccessCarriage House Living Area with Cozy Seating and Entertainment Options*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The gourmet kitchen offers beautiful Gulf views alongside premium appliances and plenty of space for preparing meals together. Gather around the dining table for a family dinner, enjoy a casual breakfast at the kitchen island or take your meal outside to the Gulf-view dining area. The carriage house also features a kitchenette for added convenience.Gourmet Kitchen with high-end appliances and ample counter spaceDining Table with seating for 8, plus bistro seating for 2 and 2 seats at the kitchen islandOutdoor Teak Dining Area with seating for 4 and Gulf viewsCarriage House Kitchenette for added flexibility*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***With beautiful Gulf views and plenty of room to unwind, the outdoor spaces at "Always On My Mind" are a highlight of the home. Spend sunny afternoons beside the private pool, relax on the first-floor patio or settle onto the second-floor balcony to enjoy the coastal breeze. An outdoor grill and dining area make it easy to spend evenings outside together.Private Seasonally Heated Pool (September - April)Poolside Deck with loungers in a secluded area between the main house and carriage houseFirst-Floor Gulf-Front Patio with custom swing, teak chairs and ample green spaceOutdoor Grill and Dining Area on the first-floor patioSecond-Floor Balcony with panoramic Gulf views*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With five bedrooms spread between the main house and carriage house, "Always On My Mind" offers a comfortable layout for families and groups traveling together.1st Floor:Primary Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with single vanity & walk-in showerHalf Bath Conveniently located off the living area2nd Floor:Full Guest Suite: Two full beds, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with single vanity & shower/tub comboTwin Guest Suite: Two twin beds, flat-screen TV, Gulf-front balcony access and En-Suite with single vanity & shower/tub comboPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, Gulf-front balcony and En-Suite with dual vanities, soaking tub & walk-in showerCarriage House:Queen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo*** ADDITIONAL HOME PERKS ***Dedicated workspace for remote work or studyingHigh-speed Wi-Fi for seamless connectivityWasher and dryer for guest convenience7 beach bikes available for your use to explore 30A*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in Seacrest West, "Always On My Mind" offers a beautiful Gulf-front setting with some of 30A's favorite communities just a short drive away. Spend the afternoon exploring the shops and restaurants of Alys Beach, enjoy dinner in Rosemary Beach or head to The Big Chill for live music and entertainment.Alys Beach for beautiful architecture, shopping, dining and scenic green spacesRosemary Beach for boutiques, coffee shops, restaurants and its charming Town CenterThe Big Chill for restaurants, live music and family-friendly entertainmentScenic Highway 30A Bike Path for exploring nearby communities*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Pool Heating is available from September 1 through April 30Waiver required to access the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 81064STRO #: STR-081064 Read less
